title: Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Meeting decision + Outlook Report (MPM Oct 29-30)
source: NEWS: boj.or.jp 'Monetary Policy Meetings' schedule page (en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/), fetched raw (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and column-parsed out of the HTML table direct 2026-09-05 during this event's own initial research. The table's columns are 'Date of MPM | Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', and the October 2026 row reads 'Oct. 29 (Thurs.), 30 (Fri.)' with 'Oct. 30 (Fri.)' in the Outlook column, 'Nov. 10 (Tues.)' for the Summary of Opinions and 'Dec. 23 (Wed.)' for the Minutes; the decision publishes at the meeting's conclusion on the second day. CORRECTION (2026-09-05, this event's initial research): this line previously read 'Nov. 5 (Thurs.)' as the Summary of Opinions — that is the Sept. 17-18 meeting's MINUTES, read one row and one column adrift. October is confirmed to be a quarterly Outlook Report meeting (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec all read '-' in that column), so it carries fresh staff projections as well as the rate decision. Filed estimate on two counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: and no slot for any other central bank, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Understating the label only widens caution.
notes: Proposed during the boj-decision-2026-09-18 initial research (2026-09-05). It is the next venue after the 09-18 decision and the scoring date for FT-boj-decision-2026-09-18-2, which predicts the policy rate at or below 1.25% immediately after this meeting — i.e. at most one hike across 09-18 and 10-30 combined. SAME CHANNEL, SAME CAVEAT AS THE SEPTEMBER ENTRY: a BoJ move propagates to this calendar's long-duration AI names through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both already owned by the FOMC ledger; symbols is empty and no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed. Policy rate is 1.0% as of the 2026-07-31 statement (8-1, Takata dissenting for 1.25%) — see boj-decision-2026-09-18.json for the primary citation. IMPACT IS MEDIUM for the same reason as September, with one upgrade candidate the next pulse should weigh: this is a quarterly Outlook Report meeting, so the projections that carry the BoJ's whole forward-looking hawkish case ('clearly above 2 percent from the second half of fiscal 2026') get revised here in public. The decision announcement lands overnight ET and reaches the US tape as a 10-30 open. Date is the JST decision date, matching how the BoJ publishes it. CORRECTION (2026-09-05, this event's initial research): the adjacency note previously read 'the 2026-10-29 FOMC decision the day before, and the 2026-10-29 mega-cap print cluster (AAPL/AMZN/META)'. The FOMC decision is 2026-10-28 (confirmed, FED: primary — see fomc-2026-10-28.json), two days before, and the mega-cap cluster splits META + GOOG on 10-28 and AAPL + AMZN on 10-29 (all estimate, 8-K cadence). ATTRIBUTION IS THE HARD PART AND IT IS NOW MEASURED: 28 tracked events sit within +/-5 days of this date (event-material-decide.mjs's own window, computed 2026-09-05) against 14 for the 09-18 decision, and 10-30 itself also carries ECI Q3 (confirmed, 08:30 ET) and Chicago PMI (estimate, 09:45 ET) plus the AAPL/AMZN print reactions at the same open. See docs/research/events/boj-decision-2026-10-30.md for the full ledger.
